note: The operations the organization ledger writer (.github/workflows/organization-ledger-writer.yml, job ledger-ingest) runs from the committed ingest request beside this file. The job is selected by control/workflow-surface-registry.json writer_jobs[] (paths .stegverse/organization-ledger-ingest/**); the operation is read from the request by resident-runtime/organization_ledger_ingest.py. Same manifest as StegVerse-Labs/.github, which runs sv_check_receipt as well; this organization declares the operations it runs: sealed_test_receipt, sv_push_receipt and sv_change_admit.

organization_ledger_writer_operations.append_path: resident-runtime/aggregate_repo_transition.py::append under the store's exclusive section (source bound by resident-runtime/organization_ledger_ingest.py::sealed_source)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.evidence_location: the producer's sealed receipt unchanged at source-receipts/<receipt_sha256>.json, consumed by one organization receipt whose source_transition_sha256 is that receipt_sha256
organization_ledger_writer_operations.admission: .stegverse/organization-ledger-ingest/accepted-sealed-receipts.json kinds only; seal over the canonical body; ALLOW, no refusals, tests >= 1 and skipped/failed/errors 0; ledger_candidate.target this organization's ledger; request provenance names the producer repository, head and run; any failure -> six-field FAIL_CLOSED before any write
organization_ledger_writer_operations.invoked_by: .github/workflows/organization-ledger-writer.yml job ledger-ingest (push to main touching .stegverse/organization-ledger-ingest/** with request operation sealed_test_receipt; ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_LOCK); no dispatch input, no schedule
organization_ledger_writer_operations.hb_reference: the supplied epoch the ledger head carries (merge_transfer.head_epoch); no clock
organization_ledger_writer_operations.readback: resident-runtime/organization_ledger_ingest.py readback-sealed on a fresh fetch of the published ref

organization_ledger_writer_operations.append_path: resident-runtime/sv_push_receipt_append.py::_append_one (the range lookup, then repository ledger .stegverse/transition-ledger/emit.py::append, then resident-runtime/aggregate_repo_transition.py::append, the two-level append resident-runtime/merge_transfer.py uses; intr_destination_ingress.py and aggregate_repo_transition.py unedited)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.evidence_schema_file: schemas/sv-push-receipt.v1.schema.json (emitted by resident-runtime/sv_push_receipt.py; the shape and seal check is that module's receipt_problem)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.evidence_location: repository receipt $.evidence (the complete push receipt, self-identified by $.evidence.schema), retained beside the organization receipt at source-receipts/<hex>.json
organization_ledger_writer_operations.ledger_ownership: a push receipt is recorded on the ledger of the organization that owns the pushed repository (Coordination ruling, StegVerse-org/.github#167); this ledger records receipts for StegVerse-org repositories, and each organization keeps its own ledger
organization_ledger_writer_operations.invoked_by: .github/workflows/organization-ledger-writer.yml job ledger-ingest (push to main touching .stegverse/organization-ledger-ingest/request.json with operation sv_push_receipt, read by resident-runtime/organization_ledger_ingest.py; ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_LOCK); no dispatch input, no schedule
organization_ledger_writer_operations.one_receipt_per_range: the range is (repository, ref, old_sha, new_sha); the repository transition id is SV_PUSH_RECEIPT_APPEND:<sha256 of that range>, so one range has one receipt; a second receipt for a range the ledger already records, byte-identical or not, -> six-field FAIL_CLOSED SV_PUSH_RECEIPT_RANGE_ALREADY_RECORDED, nothing appended; one request carries one receipt, one request PR per receipt (batching needs a documented change proposal)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.admission: one object whose schema is stegverse.sv_push_receipt.v1 that passes sv_push_receipt.receipt_problem (closed field set, 40-hex shas, pushed_commits ending at new_sha, supplied hb_epoch, result_sha256 seal); LEDGER_EVIDENCE_NOT_A_PUSH_RECEIPT or SV_PUSH_RECEIPT_MALFORMED otherwise, six fields, before any write
organization_ledger_writer_operations.hb_reference: supplied epoch only, from the committed ingest request (integer >= 32) and equal to the receipt's own hb_epoch; derived_from_clock false or the operation fails closed
organization_ledger_writer_operations.epoch_rule: resident-runtime/aggregate_repo_transition.py::supplied_epoch_failure (byte-identical to resident-runtime/organization_egress_boundary.py::supplied_epoch_failure), source sha256 pinned as epoch_rule_sha256
organization_ledger_writer_operations.epoch_tie: append epoch or receipt hb_epoch (both epoch-source fields) absent, null, "", "null" or UNKNOWN_NOT_AUTHENTICALLY_OBSERVED -> FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED; any other malformed value or a differing value -> DENY HB_EPOCH_MISMATCH; a stored hb_reference that is unsealed or clock-derived -> FAIL_CLOSED HB_EPOCH_SOURCE_UNOBSERVED
organization_ledger_writer_operations.readback: resident-runtime/sv_push_receipt_append.py readback on a fresh fetch of the published ref (sealed pair, linked, valid evidence, exactly one receipt for the range)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.verifier: clock-free and network-free: reads the committed request, the receipt and the declared ledger store only

organization_ledger_writer_operations.append_path: resident-runtime/sv_change_admit_append.py::append_change_admit (the change lookup, the P1 sv_work_items.transition chain SV_CHANGE_SUPERSEDE -> SV_CHANGE_VERIFY -> SV_CHANGE_ADMIT, then sv_work_items.record -> repository ledger .stegverse/transition-ledger/emit.py::append -> resident-runtime/aggregate_repo_transition.py::append, the two-level append sv_push_receipt_append.py uses, under ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_LOCK; intr_destination_ingress.py and aggregate_repo_transition.py unedited)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.evidence_schema: stegverse.sv_change.v1 (the change record, in $.evidence.record, with the lifecycle outcome and its six fields)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.evidence_schema_file: tests/vendor/p1_f28c3a76/ (P1's sv_work_items.py validate_change and lifecycle-transitions.json, with the pinned kernel.py, node_store.py and worker-claim script, verified against data/sv-work-items/contract-pins.json sha256 5c0c98d4349274b547a7c4ba8154e77e930e55e0a8dc1827344229661957a4cb before use; this organization holds no sv_work_items.py of its own)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.evidence_location: repository receipt $.evidence (record, disposition, the six fields, invariant, and $.evidence.observed: the current base: ledger head read from the ledger, registry generation supplied in the request and labelled so, the push receipts read from the ledger, the step chain), retained beside the organization receipt at source-receipts/<hex>.json
organization_ledger_writer_operations.invoked_by: .github/workflows/organization-ledger-writer.yml job ledger-ingest (push to main touching .stegverse/organization-ledger-ingest/request.json with operation sv_change_admit, read by resident-runtime/organization_ledger_ingest.py; ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_LOCK); no dispatch input, no schedule, no new workflow
organization_ledger_writer_operations.owning_ledger: StegVerse-org: a change whose $.target_repository is a StegVerse-org repository (StegVerse-SDK included) is admitted on this ledger only (CHANGE_BINDS_TARGET_REPOSITORY_LEDGER); StegVerse-Labs changes are admitted on StegVerse-Labs/.github's own ledger by that repository's declaration of this operation; any other target -> six-field FAIL_CLOSED SV_CHANGE_TARGET_NOT_OWNED_BY_THIS_LEDGER before any write
organization_ledger_writer_operations.one_admit_per_change: the repository transition id is <change_id>:SV_CHANGE_ADMIT (sv_work_items.record); a second request for a change the ledger already records an admit for, byte-identical or not, -> six-field FAIL_CLOSED SV_CHANGE_ADMIT_ALREADY_RECORDED, nothing appended, confers nothing; the refusal is the green steady state
organization_ledger_writer_operations.admission: predecessor and successor stegverse.sv_change.v1 objects and admission {predicate_digest, corpus_head, actor_session, change_commits{base_commit, head_commit}, push_ranges[{repository, ref, old_sha, new_sha}], registry_generation (int)}; SV_CHANGE_ADMIT_REQUEST_MALFORMED otherwise, six fields, before any write. The push receipts and the ledger head are never taken from the request: each range is looked up as SV_PUSH_RECEIPT_APPEND:<range id> on the declared ledger and the current base ledger_head is the ledger ref commit. This checkout holds no task registry, so registry_generation is the one supplied base value and the recorded evidence says so (SUPPLIED_IN_REQUEST_NOT_OBSERVED_BY_THIS_CHECKOUT). A recorded outcome is whatever sv_work_items returned (ALLOW, DENY or FAIL_CLOSED, six fields on every non-ALLOW); required-check receipts, sign-offs and resolved SV_ISSUE facts are not supplied by this operation, so a change that needs them is recorded as refused, never as ALLOW
organization_ledger_writer_operations.hb_reference: supplied epoch only, from the committed ingest request (integer >= 32) and equal to the NATIVE successor's own hb_epoch; derived_from_clock false or the operation fails closed
organization_ledger_writer_operations.epoch_rule: resident-runtime/aggregate_repo_transition.py::supplied_epoch_failure, SHARED_RULE_SHA256 7f36f0e697cadc91acd27af121eee3fc460b887ec67cfa258727bfccec0ca5f8 (the sv_push_receipt operation's rule in this organization); the stored hb_reference.epoch is checked by sv_push_receipt_append._stored_epoch_refusal
organization_ledger_writer_operations.readback: resident-runtime/sv_change_admit_append.py readback on a fresh fetch of the published ref (sealed pair, linked, the recorded lifecycle outcome, exactly one SV_CHANGE_ADMIT receipt for the change)
organization_ledger_writer_operations.verifier: clock-free and network-free: reads the committed request, the declared ledger store and the vendored P1 files only
